verdict.rationale: The pack has no evidence that Zapier lets users browse past execution logs or replay a failed run from the failing step. The only related items are help-center troubleshooting guidance and AI-generated troubleshooting instructions. Those are an adjacent error-help feature, not execution history or resume-from-step replay.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can inspect past execution logs and re-run a failed execution, resuming from the failing step
